injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.comment: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: CJ McCollum
injuries.comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.comment: Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
injuries.comment: Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.

injuries.name: Grayson Allen
injuries.comment: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.comment: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

injuries.name: Sion James
injuries.comment: James is probable for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to general soreness.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.comment: Smith (illness) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.comment: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
injuries.comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

injuries.name: Tobi Lawal
injuries.comment: Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.comment: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.comment: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Cade Cunningham
injuries.comment: Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Ebuka Okorie
injuries.comment: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.comment: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.comment: Robinson (quadriceps) is considered day-to-day as he progresses in his rehab, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.comment: Duren (hamstring) is being assigned to the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday for practice as he ramps up for a return, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Yaxel Lendeborg
injuries.comment: Lendeborg is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Kings with an illness.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.comment: Head coach Steve Kerr said Tuesday that Williams (hamstring) is questionable to play Wednesday against the Kings, per Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.comment: McConnell (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Aaron Nesmith
injuries.comment: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

injuries.name: Larry Nance Jr.
injuries.comment: Nance exited Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle and he will not return, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Austin Reaves
injuries.comment: Coach JJ Redick stated Monday that the team is optimistic Reaves (heel) will return for Friday's game against San Antonio, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.comment: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Cameron Boozer
injuries.comment: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jerami Grant
injuries.comment: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injuries.comment: Antetokounmpo (groin) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Julian Reese
injuries.comment: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.comment: Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.comment: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Josh Hart
injuries.comment: Hart (shoulder) has been upgraded to probable for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Miles McBride
injuries.comment: McBride (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
injuries.comment: Towns (knee) is probable for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Jalen Brunson
injuries.comment: Brunson (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Jordan Clarkson
injuries.comment: Clarkson (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: OG Anunoby
injuries.comment: Anunoby (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.comment: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Aday Mara
injuries.comment: Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.comment: Embiid (illness) is listed as doubtful for Wednesday's game versus Miami.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.comment: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.comment: Raynaud (knee) was assigned to the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.comment: Fox (shin) is questionable to play Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Victor Wembanyama
injuries.comment: Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Portland.

injuries.name: Dylan Harper
injuries.comment: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.comment: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: RJ Barrett
injuries.comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries.comment: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.comment: Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
